verdict.rationale: Heap documents a Session Replay product (an add-on) whose replays are cued to events, and it claims you can exclude sensitive information from sessions. The evidence does not show that sensitive input is masked by default in replays: the masking docs describe the analytics dataset, and the text-redaction setting is opt-in. Missing for 10: evidence that replay masks sensitive input by default, replay-specific masking documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default
